reason: The image-only reading gave the issuer, father and notary but not the structure of the act; the reread on native crops identifies the inserted legatine faculty with its papal-year words at the fold, the Ingolstadt dating clause and the notary's subscription naming Eisengrein as protonotary and count palatine.
sources: L. von Pastor, Erläuterungen und Ergänzungen zu Janssens Geschichte des deutschen Volkes (1908): Eisengrein 'päpstlicher Protonotar, Pfalzgraf vom Lateran und kaiserlicher Pfalzgraf'; 'Schon im Jahre 1563 war er von dem Legaten Zacharias Delfino zum päpstlichen Protonotar ernannt worden' (Google Books InRHAQAAMAAJ, snippet)
Annales Ingolstadiensis academiae (1580): 'EISENGREIN, D. Theologus, Protonotarius, Comes Palatinus Apostolicus & Caesareus' (Google Books TDJRAAAAcAAJ, snippet)
G. von Pölnitz (ed.), Die Matrikel der Ludwig-Maximilians-Universität Ingolstadt-Landshut-München (1937): a 'Michael Aurbach' (Google Books lbMIib0MvQoC, snippet, date not seen)
text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader, Claude), reread on the native image: the display line and the whole text face (canvas 1, Stams_STA_Frg_189_01v, 4912 x 7360) in six bands, each in two overlapping halves (x 1150-2700 and 2450-4000; bands starting y 1120, 1650, 2180, 2710, 3240, 3770, 600 px tall), with detail crops of the display line, line 5 (beneficiary), lines 8-9 (faculty address), the fold line, the line naming Iohannes, the dating lines, the subscription and the sign, and of the back label and notes (canvas 0). Read with knowledge of Martin Eisengrein's titles and of the nuncio Zaccaria Delfino; no outside text of the act exists. Left starts and right ends of lines are physically lost at the trimmed edges ([...]). Expansions in parentheses, uncertain readings (?).
